title.en: How HTML, CSS and JavaScript divide work

summary.zh-CN: HTML 描述结构与内容，CSS 描述样式与布局，JavaScript 描述交互与行为；三者分层让页面可维护、可访问。
summary.en: HTML describes structure and content, CSS describes presentation and layout, and JavaScript describes interaction; the separation keeps pages maintainable and accessible.

zh-CN: 区分结构、表现、行为三层各自负责的内容
判断一段需求应放在 HTML、CSS 还是 JavaScript
en: Separate the structure, presentation and behavior layers
Decide whether a requirement belongs in HTML, CSS or JavaScript

prompt.zh-CN: 列出页面中的标题、按钮样式、点击后弹出提示三处分别由哪一层实现，并说明把样式直接写进 HTML 的坏处。
prompt.en: For a heading, a button style and a click alert, name the responsible layer and explain the drawback of inline styles in HTML.

hint.zh-CN: 内容与语义归 HTML，外观归 CSS，行为归 JavaScript；内联样式无法复用且难维护。
hint.en: Content and semantics belong to HTML, appearance to CSS and behavior to JavaScript; inline styles cannot be reused and are hard to maintain.

summary.zh-CN: 用 header/nav/main/article/footer/button 等元素表达含义，让屏幕阅读器、搜索引擎和开发者都能理解结构。
summary.en: Use elements such as header, nav, main, article, footer and button to express meaning so screen readers, search engines and developers all understand the structure.

zh-CN: 用语义元素搭出页面骨架
把可点击的 div 改成 button 或 a 并说明原因
en: Build a page skeleton from semantic elements
Replace a clickable div with button or a and explain why

prompt.zh-CN: 把一段全是 div 的页面骨架改写成语义元素，并指出哪一处会让键盘用户受益。
prompt.en: Rewrite a page skeleton made only of divs into semantic elements and point out which change helps keyboard users.

hint.zh-CN: 导航用 nav、主内容用 main、独立内容用 article；可交互元素优先 button/a。
hint.en: Use nav for navigation, main for the primary content and article for independent content; prefer button/a for interactive elements.

summary.zh-CN: 每个元素都是 content + padding + border + margin 组成的盒子；box-sizing 决定 width 是否包含内边距与边框。
summary.en: Every element is a box of content, padding, border and margin; box-sizing decides whether width includes padding and border.

zh-CN: 画出盒模型四层并计算元素实际占位
解释 border-box 与 content-box 的差异
en: Draw the four box layers and compute the space an element takes
Explain border-box versus content-box

prompt.zh-CN: 一个 width: 200px、padding: 20px、border: 2px 的元素在两种 box-sizing 下各占多少宽度？写出计算过程。
prompt.en: An element with width 200px, padding 20px and border 2px: how wide is it under each box-sizing value? Show the arithmetic.

hint.zh-CN: content-box 是 200+20×2+2×2；border-box 时内容区被压缩，总宽仍是 200。
hint.en: content-box gives 200+20×2+2×2; with border-box the total stays 200 and the content area shrinks.

summary.zh-CN: 同一元素可能被多条规则命中；层叠按来源、优先级与顺序决定最终样式，优先级高的规则不一定更易维护。
summary.en: Several rules can match one element; the cascade resolves them by origin, specificity and order, and higher specificity is not always easier to maintain.

zh-CN: 计算简单选择器组合的优先级
用低优先级选择器和变量组织可覆盖的样式
en: Compute specificity for simple selector combinations
Organize overridable styles with low-specificity selectors and variables

prompt.zh-CN: 给出三条命中同一标题的规则，判断哪条生效并说明原因。
prompt.en: Given three rules matching the same heading, decide which one wins and explain why.

hint.zh-CN: 先比 !important 与来源，再比 ID/类/元素数量，最后比出现顺序。
hint.en: Compare !important and origin first, then ID/class/element counts, and finally source order.

summary.zh-CN: display:flex 按主轴与交叉轴排布子项，适合一行或一列的分布、对齐与换行。
summary.en: display:flex lays out children along a main and a cross axis, which suits distribution, alignment and wrapping in a row or column.

zh-CN: 用 justify-content 与 align-items 完成水平垂直居中
用 flex-wrap 与 gap 组织可换行列表
en: Center content horizontally and vertically with justify-content and align-items
Build a wrapping list with flex-wrap and gap

prompt.zh-CN: 用 Flexbox 实现一个水平居中、垂直居中且带 12px 间距的三卡片行，写出完整 CSS。
prompt.en: Use Flexbox to build a three-card row centered both ways with 12px gaps, and write the complete CSS.

hint.zh-CN: 容器 display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:12px。
hint.en: The container needs display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:12px.

summary.zh-CN: display:grid 同时控制行与列，适合整体页面布局和需要精确对齐的卡片网格。
summary.en: display:grid controls rows and columns together, which suits page layout and card grids that need precise alignment.

zh-CN: 用 grid-template-columns 定义列并设置间距
用 minmax 与 auto-fit 实现自适应卡片列
en: Define columns and gaps with grid-template-columns
Use minmax and auto-fit for adaptive card columns

prompt.zh-CN: 用 Grid 写一个三列布局，窄屏时自动变成一列，并说明 Flexbox 与 Grid 的选择依据。
prompt.en: Write a three-column layout that collapses to one column on narrow screens and explain how to choose between Flexbox and Grid.

hint.zh-CN: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)) 可自适应列数；一维用 Flex，二维用 Grid。
hint.en: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)) adapts the column count; use Flex for one dimension and Grid for two.

summary.zh-CN: 用 viewport 元标签、相对单位和媒体查询按屏幕宽度调整布局；移动优先先写窄屏样式再逐级增强。
summary.en: Use the viewport meta tag, relative units and media queries to adapt layout to screen width; mobile first writes the narrow layout and enhances upward.

zh-CN: 设置 viewport 并解释它解决什么问题
用 min-width 媒体查询按移动优先顺序覆盖样式
en: Set the viewport and explain the problem it solves
Override styles with min-width media queries in mobile-first order

prompt.zh-CN: 为一张卡片写移动优先样式：窄屏单列，宽度 ≥640px 时两列；写出 viewport 与媒体查询。
prompt.en: Write mobile-first styles for a card: one column on narrow screens and two columns from 640px; include the viewport tag and media query.

hint.zh-CN: 先写默认单列，再用 @media (min-width: 640px) 增加两列；断点取自内容需要而非设备型号。
hint.en: Write the single column by default and add two columns in @media (min-width: 640px); choose breakpoints from content needs, not device models.

summary.zh-CN: 浏览器把 HTML 解析成 DOM 树；JavaScript 通过选择元素、监听事件和更新节点来驱动交互。
summary.en: The browser parses HTML into a DOM tree; JavaScript drives interaction by selecting elements, listening to events and updating nodes.

zh-CN: 用 querySelector 选中元素并绑定点击事件
解释事件委托与直接绑定的取舍
en: Select an element with querySelector and bind a click handler
Explain event delegation versus direct binding

prompt.zh-CN: 给列表写一个事件委托的删除按钮处理函数，并说明为什么不为每个按钮单独绑定。
prompt.en: Write an event-delegated delete handler for a list and explain why you do not bind every button individually.

hint.zh-CN: 把监听器绑在父元素上，通过 event.target.closest('button') 找到实际按钮。
hint.en: Bind the listener on the parent and find the real button with event.target.closest('button').

summary.zh-CN: fetch 返回 Promise，需要检查 response.ok 并解析 JSON；用 async/await 与 try/catch 组织错误处理。
summary.en: fetch returns a Promise, so check response.ok and parse JSON; organize error handling with async/await and try/catch.

zh-CN: 用 async/await 调用接口并检查 ok
区分网络失败、HTTP 错误与解析失败
en: Call an API with async/await and check ok
Separate network failure, HTTP errors and parse failures

prompt.zh-CN: 写一个加载用户列表的函数，分别处理网络异常、404 和返回非 JSON 三种情况。
prompt.en: Write a function that loads a user list and handles network failure, a 404 and a non-JSON response separately.

hint.zh-CN: fetch 只有网络层失败才 reject；404 需要自己检查 response.ok 再抛错。
hint.en: fetch rejects only on network failure; a 404 requires an explicit response.ok check and your own error.

summary.zh-CN: 语义标记、替代文本、配色对比度和键盘可用性共同决定页面是否可访问；ARIA 只用于补语义缺口。
summary.en: Semantic markup, alternative text, color contrast and keyboard usability together determine accessibility; ARIA is only for filling semantic gaps.

zh-CN: 为图片和控件提供可读名称
用对比度标准检查文字可读性
en: Provide readable names for images and controls
Check text readability against contrast criteria

prompt.zh-CN: 检查一个只靠颜色区分状态的按钮列表，给出两种让状态可被非视觉用户感知的改法。
prompt.en: Inspect a button list that shows state by color alone and propose two ways to make state perceivable without vision.

hint.zh-CN: 补充图标或文字标签，并给 aria-pressed/aria-current 等状态语义。
hint.en: Add an icon or text label and expose state semantics such as aria-pressed or aria-current.

title.zh-CN: 键盘可用性与焦点管理

summary.zh-CN: 所有可交互元素要能 Tab 到达并有可见焦点；不要用 outline:none 移除焦点样式而不提供替代。
summary.en: Every interactive element must be reachable with Tab and show a visible focus indicator; never remove focus styles with outline:none without a replacement.

zh-CN: 检查页面的 Tab 顺序是否合理
为自定义控件提供可见焦点样式
en: Check whether the Tab order is sensible
Provide a visible focus style for custom controls

prompt.zh-CN: 为一个自定义下拉组件补全键盘行为：Tab 可进入、方向键切换、Esc 关闭，并给出焦点样式。
prompt.en: Complete keyboard behavior for a custom dropdown: Tab to enter, arrow keys to move, Esc to close, plus a focus style.

hint.zh-CN: 优先使用原生 select/button；必须自定义时补 role、aria-expanded 与键盘事件。
hint.en: Prefer native select/button; when customizing, add role, aria-expanded and keyboard handlers.

summary.zh-CN: rem 相对根字号、em 相对父字号、% 与 vw/vh 相对容器或视口；排版使用相对单位更利于缩放与无障碍。
summary.en: rem is relative to the root font size, em to the parent font size, and % and vw/vh to the container or viewport; relative units support zoom and accessibility.

zh-CN: 区分 px、rem、em 的参照对象
用相对单位设置字号与间距
en: Distinguish what px, rem and em are relative to
Set font sizes and spacing with relative units

prompt.zh-CN: 把一段全部用 px 的字号与间距改成 rem，并说明用户放大字号时会怎样变化。
prompt.en: Convert a block of px font sizes and spacing to rem and explain what happens when the user enlarges the browser font size.

hint.zh-CN: 1rem 通常等于 16px；rem 随根字号缩放，px 不会。
hint.en: 1rem is usually 16px; rem scales with the root font size while px does not.

title.zh-CN: 用开发者工具验证页面

summary.zh-CN: 浏览器开发者工具可以检查盒模型、计算样式、网络请求和无障碍树；改完必须重新观察证据，而不是假设生效。
summary.en: DevTools inspects the box model, computed styles, network requests and the accessibility tree; after a change you must re-observe evidence instead of assuming it worked.

zh-CN: 在 Elements 面板检查盒模型与计算样式
在 Network/Console 面板获取失败请求的证据
en: Inspect the box model and computed styles in the Elements panel
Gather failing-request evidence from the Network and Console panels

prompt.zh-CN: 为一个样式没生效的按钮写排查步骤：用 DevTools 证明规则是否命中、被谁覆盖、最终计算值是什么。
prompt.en: Write debugging steps for a button style that does not apply: use DevTools to prove whether the rule matched, was overridden and what the computed value is.

hint.zh-CN: 看 Styles 面板的删除线、Computed 面板的计算值，以及盒模型示意图。
hint.en: Look at struck-through rules in Styles, the computed values in Computed and the box-model diagram.
